sentences.en: I'd like bread, cheese and ham.
Do you have fresh fish today?

sentences.en: The eggs and the milk are over there.

sentences.pt: Os ovos e o leite estão ali.

passages.text: Hoy el pescado está muy bien, la merluza ha llegado esta mañana. Las fresas también están de oferta, a dos euros la caja. Lo que no me queda es pan integral, solo el blanco.
passages.en: The fish is really good today, the hake came in this morning. Strawberries are on offer too, two euros a box. What I don't have left is wholemeal bread, only white.
passages.question: What can you NOT buy today?

passages.text: Hoje o peixe está muito bom, a pescada chegou esta manhã. Os morangos também estão em promoção, a dois euros a caixa. O que já não tenho é pão integral, só o branco.
passages.en: The fish is really good today, the hake came in this morning. Strawberries are on offer too, two euros a box. What I don't have any more is wholemeal bread, only white.
passages.question: What can you NOT buy today?
